name: Gmail Pub/Sub
summary: Gmail push notifications let an agent react to new mail instead of polling. You call users.watch on a mailbox with a Google Cloud Pub/Sub topic; Gmail then publishes a small message (email address and new historyId) whenever the mailbox changes, and your service fetches the actual changes with history.list. Pub/Sub can push to an HTTPS webhook or be pulled by a worker.
facts: Pub/Sub topic with publish rights for gmail-api-push@system.gserviceaccount.com
At least every 7 days (Google recommends daily)
emailAddress and historyId only; fetch details via history.list
1 notification per second per user; excess dropped
Pub/Sub usage billed at Google Cloud rates
goodFor: Triaging or answering email as it arrives
Feeding mail into a sandboxed reader agent
watchOut: Needs a Google Cloud project and a public HTTPS endpoint for push
Notifications can be delayed or dropped; keep a periodic history.list fallback
Incoming mail is untrusted input (prompt-injection risk)
